jev.wording: Does `candidate_column` hold the same attribute as `source_column`?

criteria.true: Both columns record the same property of the same kind of entity; names, abbreviations and value formats may differ.
criteria.false: The columns record different properties, even if their names or values look similar.

jev.selection: W0-W3 run once each on the 24 dev pairs in hybrid mode at N=10; W2 had the highest mean expected Recall@GT (0.994; W1 0.979, W3 0.971, W0 0.934). N in {5,10,25} run with W2 in hybrid mode; N=10 highest (0.994; N=5 0.991, N=25 0.985).
deviations_from_spec: Sample-size sweep ran in hybrid mode only (budget). Instance mode uses the same N.
N=50 was not run: N=25 was already below N=10.
Stability repeats (runs 2 and 3) run in hybrid mode only (budget). Schema and instance modes have one dev run.

haiku.selection: Dev split, W2 wording, N=10, effort low: thinking disabled 0.9014 vs adaptive 0.9019 mean expected Recall@GT (tie within noise); cost tie-breaker -> disabled.

baselines.instance_sample_size_note: Package default. The paper's matchers read all rows; a dev-split sensitivity run uses all rows for the 3 instance matchers.
baselines.selection: Grid over paper Table II ranges on the 24 dev pairs (1,000-row sample); highest mean expected Recall@GT, median wall time as tie-breaker.
